description: List/filter the authenticated user's successful sales, most recent first. Supports date, email, product/order filters and cursor pagination via page_key. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/sales.

after.description: Only sales after this date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Only sales before this date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

email.description: Filter to sales to this buyer email.

order_id.description: Filter to a specific order id.

page_key.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous response's next_page_key to fetch the next page.

product_id.description: Filter to sales of this product id.

name: gumroad_list_sales
title: List sales
